## Chapter Twenty-Two

Distant Memories



Lucas got up the next morning and showered, he bypassed the main hall avoiding the group and heading straight for the room with the machine, approaching he could hear clanking noises and a few muffled curses through the closed door.

He opened it quietly and entered, finding Victoria already there standing near the machine and looking down at a pair of legs belonging to Emma, there were wire pieces and parts strewn all over the immediate area and it looked as if she had taken the damn thing apart. “Wow” Lucas said, really not knowing how else to react to this. They still needed to get into the vault and their ace hardware person had spent all night tinkering with this damn thing.

“What’s going on” he continued when no one looked up. He waited patiently and was about to ask again when Emma’s muffled voice came from beneath the panel of the large machine “One Minute” She said simply and Lucas settled in to wait, he had no idea what the machine was, but as with anything machine related Emma had jumped into it with both feet, he swallowed the irritation over them getting sidetracked, they needed to get into the armory not worry about some crazy medical scanner. But that wouldn’t be helpful to start that fight, besides he was curious as to what the damn thing did.

Suddenly a loud electronic whirring sound along with bright blue lights began to coalesce from the sides of the machine, but it still wasn’t loud enough to damped the excited squeal that came from the pair of legs as they slid out from under the machine.

Emma jumped up and quickly went over to the terminal, with a motion of her hand a login screen came up hovering above the desk. Motioned to Victoria Emma stepped back and walked over to Lucas who stood there with an arched eyebrow eyeing the machine and leaning on the wall, at what he considered a safe distance from the thing.

“Okay, if this is what I think it is , it might be very helpful to us in figuring out not only access codes but also what went on here” she remarked, looking back at Victoria with a look of love and excitement as the other woman hunkered down , grabbing small boxes from a bag that had been slung over her shoulder. “What is she doing?” Lucas wondered aloud nodding his head towards her fiancé. A large smile of pride spread across Emma’s face as she continued to look lovingly at Victoria. “She is going to crack the login for the machine and get us in, once we are in, I should be able to confirm my suspicions, although this would be a very early version of the system I am thinking of” she finished. “What the hell do you think it is?” Lucas asked and Emma turned to him. “I don’t know for sure, but I think it might be a really early version of a memory scanner” she said, getting a blank look from Lucas. “Is that some kind of computer diagnostic thing?” he asked trying to prod her into explaining the obscure term.

A small laugh erupted from the small pixie of a woman “No, it’s a mind scanner, its used by the current security force to document raids and such, with a small sensor placed on the forehead, the system downloads to a main computer where the sensory input of the officer is then able to be recalled for later review.” She finished. In olden times they would use video devices to the same effect, this is much more detailed and gives the state of mind and emotions of the officer as well” She finished and Lucas nodded thinking he understood where she was going with this.

“So you think they were testing this and if they did , it might give us someone who had access to the facility as well as might explain what went on here” he said letting his suspicion formulate into words. “Oh top marks my friend” she answered slapping him on the back.

They both watched as Victoria in her iron concentration went to work attacking the system, as denial after denial popped up. Her work was time consuming and methodic, and impressive to watch Lucas thought.

“What are you guys doing?” came a somewhat sleepy voice from the door, both Emma and Lucas turned to find Rolle strolling in, looking like he hadn’t slept well the night before. He bleary eyes roving from one then the other as he then focused on the machine now lit and Victoria at work on the terminal. “Wow” he simply said and then walked closer inspecting the large machine. “Aren’t you guys supposed to be working on the vault, I know Sally wanted that open ASAP” He said , poking the wires and helmet and then pulling back his finger as if the thing would bite him once provoked.

Emma smiled “We are working on it, long story and I will tell you when Sally gets here” she said “Well, you better start by why you are wasting your time with this, while the Amory door is still closed” Came the annoyed voice from the door and all turned to see Sally, wearing one of the wolfshead JumpSuits, leaning on the door frame. He did not look happy.

“Yeah, you can explain this one” Lucas said shying away from the large man. Emma walked over and explained what he and Lucas had discussed earlier, and Lucas could see the wheels turning in the big man’s head as Emma laid it out. “Okay, I can see some benefit from that, but the second you run into a brick wall, its back to the vault, I need that open” he said pointing at the two of them.

“You two” Sally began pointing at Rolle and myself “With me, we still have things that need done, and you holding up a wall here isn’t getting them done” He finished and walked out the door towards the center room. “Slave Driver” Rolle whispered as he passed Lucas heading for the same entrance. With a smile he followed both of them waving at Emma as he left and walked to the main room.

He joined the two of them around the holo table. Sally waved his hand over the large table and a crisp holo image of a city map floated over it. Lucas whistled “Emma and Vic got the table working again” he said impressed. Sally nodded “Better than ever, but that’s not why I called you here” he began and with an expanding pinch zoomed into the map showing an executive bloc in a city that Lucas didn’t recognize.

“Since we have been here, I have started to put the word out on who is still alive, we have disturbing reports of some of our ancillary informants getting picked up or simply executed, if Job knew about them, they are no longer active and, in most cases,, no longer alive. However, there is one, who was picked up yesterday, he has not been seen, but the security services have been back to his house four times already” he said then looked at the two of them. Lucas looked at the image thoughtfully as it fast forwarded through the video that appeared to have come from a stationary camera across the street and watched as four separate times in what looked like a two day period dark vehicles landed and disgorged troops , they stayed for a while and then left again. Sally stopped the video at one point and zoomed in. Lucas’s blood boiled as he looked at the still image of Job dressed in tactical clothes, leading what looked like a search operation. “I guess that this guy has information and they were going back to look for it, the fact that they went four times tells me it’s very important information” Lucas said and received a smile from Sally. “That is correct”. Lucas shook his head still staring at the face of his enemy “But how do you know they didn’t find it, they came back four times and then stopped” he asked. Sally smiled again “Because I know where he hid it and they didn’t return with the box he kept it in, which tells me they have not found it yet” he answered triumphantly “But we need that information so I am sending you two to retrieve it and get back here” Sally finished and closed the holo window.

Both men nodded solemnly and then retreated to their rooms to get ready. They both returned thirty minutes later dressed in plain black tactical BDU pants and a black long sleeve shirt. Both men had their tac suits underneath, but the clothes were so they wouldn’t stick out. It made for a bit of a bulky look but still functional. Lucas hid the knives under a long black coat as did Rolle.

Neither could wear the helmet’s as that would be very conspicuous in an executive neighborhood, as it is, they looked like generic security for a high-level member of one of the Departments. That would allow them to blend into the neighborhood and help limit questions from the neighbors as most did not stoop to speak to lowly security professionals.

But they both knew if they were trapped by an armed security squad or the vipers, they would not be able to hide, and the likely hood of fighting their way out with knives against guns was slim at best. Sally handed them the address and they were off.

It took them a few hours to fly into Philadelphia and then find the proper bloc that the man resided in. Landing they parked at a garage near the house and then walked the few blocks to his building. Each man keeping a keen eye in case the security forces left a drone or lookout at his building. The saving grace for them was that it was a Highrise so the entrance was used by a lot of people, besides if Lucas had setup a surveillance , he would have kept it to the apartment itself , ensuring that any alarm that went off, wouldn’t be false and anyone they caught on camera would have criminal intent.

They entered the building without incident and made their way to the elevator. “Which floor” Lucas asked, and Rolle pulled it up on his watch “24” he said, and Lucas hit the button. It was a short ride, as they both fidgeted impatiently. Lucas pulled up the building plan on his own watch, studying the layout of the apartments. The building was an entire bloc which meant twenty ample sized suites per floor, the hallway was a square separating the inner, cheaper apartments to the ones that faced out, giving them a view of the city. Coming off the elevator the apartment they wanted would be to the right. Once the door’s opened Lucas motioned to Rolle to follow and without a word, his friend did as they turned right, talking the long way around to the apartment in question.

They walked slowly, but not slowly enough to warrant attention, just a couple of security who were not in a hurry to return to duty. Both Lucas and Rolle kept a keen eye out, looking for any surveillance devices in the hall or alarm traps. He didn’t expect to find any, but as Dyson taught him, it was better to be overly vigilant then dead.

They turned the second corner, Lucas spying the door they were looking for on there right, about halfway down the hall, and he cursed as the door had a soldier standing outside of it , guarding the door. Well that at least confirmed they hadn’t found what they were looking for yet, but it also presented a problem. Lucas didn’t know when he was scheduled to check in, or if his vitals were being monitored, in which case if he killed him outright, they could bring more soldiers running. So he weighed his options as they slowly made there way down the hall. Closer and closer to the young man standing by the door, the soldier never looked at them opting instead to stare straight ahead, trying to look official as possible. Lucas pegged him as a rookie, both by his age and his training. As soon as they turned the corner the young man should have assessed them and seeing that they might be a threat, kept an eye on them as they passed. Lucas slowly reached under his jacket, making the move as casual as possible. As he weighed the best way to take this guy down. No one was in the hall with them, so they had that to their advantage and looking around the hallway had one security camera per quadrant, that covered the hallways. Rolle touched his arm and out of the corner of his eye he saw his friend nod subtly, Lucas spied the camera, but it was too far to see the little light that would tell him it was on or off. But by the motion he knew his friend would have activated the little device he carried and took care of that.

Lucas approached and began making small talk with Rolle as they got close enough for the guard to hear them. They both acted casual and at ease on the outside, presenting the perfect picture of a couple of guys getting off of work and making their way home. Inside Lucas was tense and nervous, scanning the far hall and every door, willing them to stay clear , should someone find them in the middle of disabling the guard, they would have two choices, run or eliminate the witness and he didn’t relish doing that to an innocent personal.

As they passed the lone guard, Lucas quickly flipped the knife in the palm of his hand and with a quick expert motion turned 180 degrees, bring the metal handle down on the center of the surprised guard’s skull. He crumbled instantly, Lucas’s hand darting out and catching the guard, gently lowering him to the floor. Rolle went immediately into action and worked on the lock, as Lucas quickly searched the guard, finding a radio earbud and a sensor box on his belt. So, they were watching his vitals, Lucas blew out a breath, he was glad he didn’t kill the kid, otherwise there would be vipers swarming the building.



As Rolle diligently worked on the lock, Lucas heard one of the apartment doors to his left open. Without thinking he hoisted the young guard up and threw one of the guards’ arms over his shoulder. “damn bobby, I told you drinking in the middle of the day was going to get you in trouble, if the boss finds out your done” Lucas said chidingly loud enough so the couple emerging from the apartment could hear. He moved his eyes as he closely watched the two, they glanced over, the woman giving a disapproving look at the three, but the man shot him a sympathetic look, they were clear, and Lucas breathed easier. Rolle caught his eyes and nodded, then continued to work on the lock pad. A moment later the latch unlocked, and Rolle slowly opened the door. Lucas waited as his friend checked for sensors and traps, after a few moments Rolle stuck his head out and nodded an all clear. With his help they maneuvered the guard into the foyer and sat him down against the wall.

Lucas reached into his belt pulling out a metal band, hitting the little button on them, they formed over the guard’s wrists and locked. He was thankful the guy was carrying zip cuffs, because both he and Rolle had not thought of bringing any. Lucas reached into a top pocket of the guard’s uniform and removed the remote key that would allow the cuffs to come off with a touch of a button and put it in his own pocket. They left the guard and walked further into the apartment, It was a large box with a central living room and two bedrooms to the left, a bathroom and small kitchen was on their left as they passed into the living room. Giving it an open layout. The large windows were shut, and the curtains drawn making the room dark. Lucas walked over and turned the lights in the main room. The apartment was completely torn apart, nothing had been left in place as cushions, paperwork, broken vases and plants as well as the TV and anything that wasn’t nailed down littered the floor, finding it hard to find a place to step on the floor as they made their way through. Both he and Rolle entered the master bedroom and quickly found the door the master bath on the far wall, the bedroom had not fared much better than the living room. They had been very thorough in their search.

They carefully made their way across the room and into the small bathroom with housed a sink, toilet and a small standing shower. Lucas and Rolle Surveyed the same damage in the bathroom as the other two but breathed easier when the shower had not been disturbed.

Rolle reached in and began to pick through the bottles of shampoo and conditioner until he found the right one. He handed it to Lucas who with a quick twist unscrewed the hidden compartment that was part of the bottle, the top part contains shampoo and the bottom a secret compartment. Reaching in, he pulled the mini silver disc’s, there were three of them, from within the compartment and slipped them into his pocket, he closed the bottle and put it back in the shower exactly where it had been found. “We need to go” Lucas said with hushed urgency to his friend.

They made their way back to the foyer, where the guard was still knocked out. They stepped over him and quickly left the apartment, closing the door behind them. As quickly as they could without running, they made their way down the fake wood paneled and maroon carpeted hall of the executive suites and waited impatiently for the elevator. After what seemed like a hundred years, the doors opened and they two of them made way for an elderly couple as they walked out of the elevator and towards their apartment. Boarding the elevator. Lucas checked to ensure he had the discs and hit the button for the lobby. They rode down quietly Lucas controlling his breathing to keep the adrenaline spike under control, he shoved his hands in his pocket so Rolle couldn’t see the shaking as his body reacted to the earlier excitement. The doors opened and they spilled out into the marble foyer of the building, They had a straight shot to the doors where he could see the sunshine of the midday.

They began walking towards the exit. They made it about halfway when two black unmarked vehicles landing quickly directly in front of the doors. “Shit” Lucas cursed, the guard must have had an emergency beacon and hit it when he came to. He chided himself for not looking for one, Rolle touched his shoulder and he looked, there was a hallway to there left, he had no idea where it went, but they didn’t have a choice , if they continued forward the guards would run diretly inot them as they tried to leave the building. They turned and hurried down the hall. He heard the main doors open and the commotion of the guards coming in and securing the foyer.

Rolle pulled the building floorplans up on his watch and began paging through them frantically, looking for any exit they could use to get out of the building. “There is a deliver door this way” he said pointing out another hall as they came upon it , they turned Lucas taking a quick look down where they had come, no guards were following them , but it wouldn’t take them long to secure there buddy and realize that the aggressors were loose I the building. They ran to the door at the end of the hall, there last best hope to escape the death that was coming for them. Lucas reached the door, extending his hand and just as his hand touched the knob the door opened, and they stood there facing a surprised security soldier. Without thinking Lucas grabbed him by the harness that he wore dragging him foreword into the hall, Rolle Grabbed the door right behind him shutting it on the two other officers before they could recover from there shock.

Lucas pulled the soldier close and at the same time reaching behind him and removing a knife, with a hard thrust he drove the blade in between the spaces in the vest the soldier wore, the blade finding his heart and killing the soldier within moments. He laid the body down, searching it quickly for anything they could use, ignoring the gun, as it was now useless to them, the soldiers outside began to bang on the outside of the door loudly. Rolle grabbed Lucas’s arm “We have to go before they figure out, they can shoot it” he said dragging Lucas back down the hall.

Just as they turned the corner towards a stairwell, they heard the loud reports as the soldiers shot the door, desperately trying to either open it or kill them, he couldn’t tell which. They bounded up the stairs two at a time, carried on fear and adrenaline as they made there upwards. Lucas knew they were limiting their options, he knew they were backing themselves into a corner, but no matter how he racked his brain he could not think of a way out of this situation, the soldiers had the building surrounded, they would go floor by floor and eventually find them, then they would die. Or worse he would find himself strapped to a machine and made to scream until he revealed the location of the complex, they didn’t know about it, but if they caught them, they would get that information from them. Lucas looked at his friend, he knew if it came to that he would have to kill Rolle and then take his own life to protect his friends.

Fear creeped into his stomach forming a ball sitting there, heavy and cold. They continued to go up, Rolle trying to keep an eye on the steps as he flipped frantically through the floor plan, but Lucas could have saved him the time and aggravation, they had no options, they had no escape and so with no other option open, they continued to climb as fast as they could. “I got nothing” Rolle breathed Lucas could hear the panic setting in, he could hear the fear in the pace of his friends breathing, he knew Rolle understood the situation and had come to the same conclusion he had. The climbed level after level, finally reaching a door at the top of the stairs, busting through the door sunlight stung their eyes causing them so squint against the bright light. After a moment Lucas was able to focus as his vision adapted quickly to the lighting difference. Looking around they found themselves on a large flat roof with machines that looked like air conditioners dotted across its surface. “Hold On” Rolle said and knelt by the door, he quickly pulled off his bag and began quickly going through it. “We have to go, now” Lucas hissed, his head on a swivel trying to see if security had made it onto the roof yet, they were sitting ducks, and there was nowhere to go from here.

He tried to remember the layout, there had to be an alternative way down from this damn roof he thought, mentally picturing every schematic file he could remember from the building and nothing was coming to mind. Rolle grumbled in frustration has he began tossing items out of his bag and then a cheer erupted from him as he held up an object Lucas had never seen. Rolle scooped the contents of his bag back into it and stood. “Do you trust me?” he asked, and Lucas didn’t need to think, he just nodded his head. “Follow me” Rolle said taking off across the roof. Lucas followed close behind, as they reached most of the way across the large gravely surface a door behind them slammed open “Don’t move” came a voice over his shoulder.

Rolle and Lucas put on speed as bullets began pinging off the large machines around them. “Grab my belt, and don’t let go” Rolle said over his shoulder and just as Lucas clamped his hands on his friends’ belt, they both launched off the edge of the roof and began to fall towards the surface fifty stories below.

Lucas fought panic as it tried to set into his mind. They began to fall faster as their bodies reached terminal velocity and then the oddest thing happened. Rolle Extended his hand, the device now strapped to his arm as it began to glow, they slowed and moved towards the building across the expanse they now fell in. “What the fuck” Lucas yelled, staring at the odd device as they continued to slow their downward descent, and accelerated towards the roof of the far building. Looking back Lucas could see the security soldiers gathering at the roofs edge “fucking vipers” he mumbled, thankful they hadn’t started shooting yet, not a moment after the thought he felt a line burn across his calf and heard the brisk report of a rifle. “Shit” he hissed, willing the device to move them faster “We are sitting ducks here man” he said loudly so Rolle could hear him. With a nod Rolle shifted something on the device and they began to pick up speed, the far building’s roof looming faster as they approached.

“Rolle, that is coming fast” Lucas said doing his best to keep the panic he was feeling out of his voice. With a nod Rolle shifted his hand, but instead of slowing they began to move even faster, Rolle looked up , trying to fiddle with something on the side of the blue glove-like device “uh-oh” he simply said and his body tensed, Lucas could feel it as the muscles in his back clenched here his hand curled against the belt. “What the fuck do you man uh-oh” Lucas said his voice cracking as the panic could no longer be held. Before Rolle could answer they hit the edge of the roof, rolling and sliding across the gravel. Lucas felt pebbles dig into his skin even through the protective tactical layer he wore. He tried to put himself into a fetal position but the speed at which he slid across the roof would not let him. He watched as Rolle continued to slide next to him. Both of them finally came to a stop just before there momentum would have carried them off the other side. With a moan Lucas stood, feeling pain come in waves up the front of his body, judging by the stumbling and groaning of his partner, he too did not fare wall from the landing. “What the hell is that thing?” Lucas asked, looking at the wrecked and sparking device attached to his friends’ hand. “Something Emma came up with, I wasn’t sure it would work, but man that was awesome” he said, his face swelling allowing him a half smile. Lucas blinked unbelieving, his friend had taken him off the edge of a roof, a fall that would have killed them both, to try a device he had no idea would work. Frustration welling in him, he slapped Rolle across the top of the head with an open palm, hitting him hard enough to sting his own hand. “Fucking asshole” he yelled. Causing Rolle to wince, but before they could continue the little spat, the forgotten Soldiers on the far building, had finally all regained their senses and bullets began to pepper the surrounding roof in earnest.

Lucas and Rolle ducked behind an air handler on the roof, desperately looking for a way down, they knew the soldiers would start to find there way down and across the building, they had only moments to figure out an exit if they wanted to be able to escape the horrible fate that awaited them both should they be caught.

Lucas spotted a door. “Lets go” he yelled at his friend. Both of them taking off at full speed to the closed door that would lead them into the safety of the building. Bullets sped past their heads and ricocheted off of the gravel around them. Lucas willed the door to be unlocked, to be open, should the door be locked, they would both be dead In mere moments. Rolle, the faster of the two reached the door two steps before Lucas and with a turn of the knob he pulled the door open and rushed inside. Lucas followed close behind, they both launched themselves down the stairs practically head first only their extended hands making contact with the wall on the first landing stopping them from killing themselves. With the door open, Bullets found their way in burying themselves just above them in the wall, the sound of metal on metal as some ricocheted off of the metal bannister.

They gathered themselves and as fast as they could bounded down the stairs, hoping they would make it faster than the solders could intercept them in the building. They practically jumped entire flights as they quickly made their way down through the building, at breakneck speeds, thoughts of what would happen should the soldiers intercept them before they could escape.

Finally, they were on the ground floor. Rolle turned right to head towards the front of the building and Lucas grabbed him before he could get away, spinning him around he pushed his friend towards the rear, the side that faced away from the building they had just come from.

The back door slammed against the side of the building as the two of them pushed out into the alleyway. Looking around there saw on one in sight, no menacing soldiers present to confront , detain and torture them. They sprinted across the alley, finding another door , this one locked, they then ran along the building until they found another alley, making their way down it. They came to the mouth of the alley they spilled out onto the street. Dyson’s training ran through his head. “When you are on the run, its best to not run, if people are chasing you, they will be looking for those who are trying to get away” the old man’s voice resounded in his head. Grabbing Rolle, he slowed his friend down, despite his fear and his body wanting to run at full tilt out into the street, to put as much distance between them and the threat, he fought it down, fought back the fear.

He pasted a serene smile on his face and holding onto his friend so he couldn’t bolt, they walked onto the pedestrian walk at a leisurely stroll, Lucas began talking about the traffic, the park upgrades, politics, whatever would come to him and his fear addled brain. Above them he could make out drones as they patrolled, looking for the escaped fugitives. “Just pretend we are on a stroll, laugh and joke, like we don’t have a care in the world.” Lucas whispered to his friend, the face smile never leaving his face.

They walked two blocks like this, no one stopped them, no one even looked twice at them, both of them kept their heads down, trying their best to not give any of the drones a clear shot at their faces. This would not do, if they recognized either one of them later.

Once they entered the parking garage, they sped up getting to the car as fast as they could. They lifted off, merging into traffic, Lucas expected a horde of vehicles to descend on them at any moment, but none did, and they made it out of the city and back to the complex without incident.

Walking into the complex, they found Sally still in the main room at one of the terminals, Lucas went over and gently laid the silver optical disk on the desk. “This is what we found in the bathroom where you told us to look” he said. “Did you have any problems?” Sally asked, looking at the scuffed and beat-up clothing and the bruises and scrapes that were now starting to bruise. Lucas nodded “Nothing we couldn’t handle” he simply said and limped back towards the entrance to the apartments. He needed a drink and a hot shower. Sally did not say anything else and allowed the two to retreat with at least a little dignity.

In a few hours, properly showered and changed both he and Rolle returned to the main room to find Emma and Victoria in a hushed conversation with Sally, all of them looking serious as they seemed to be arguing over something. Lucas cocked his head “What’s going on? “he asked looking between the three of them. All three stopped talking and turned towards Lucas and Rolle. Sally spoke first “The girls have found some interesting information on the machine in that room, but I am not sure it is going to help us” he said giving a mildly hostile look at Emma who returned it tenfold.

Crossing her arms over her chest she looked defiantly at Sally “Do you want me to explain it to them or is your lordship going to command we abandon it” Sally rolled his eyes. “Go ahead and between all of us we can decide what to do , but go get doc first, we should all hear this” he said and nodded at Rolle to go and retrieve her from the medical bay. With a nod Rolle turned and took off towards the bay, his limp was very visible now that they had rested, and the pain of the earlier incident coupled by adrenaline leaving their body. Had left both men feeling every bump and scrape from there little misadventure.

“What happened to you guys?” Vic asked looking after Rolle concerned. Lucas explained what had happened including Rolle’s use of the device that had saved them. Emma’s jaw dropped “What the hell were you thinking, it was never meant to be used like that, it’s a simple gravity manipulator allowing you to lift heavy objects by counteracting their weight using gravity” she stated unbelievingly. Lucas shrugged “Talk to captain science when he gets back, it was his bright idea, I was just along for the ride” he said. Emma still had that stunned look on her face shaking her head. “You two could have been killed” she whispered, her eyes dropping at someone dying using something she created. Lucas could imagine it was a sobering thought and that Rolle was going to get his ass kicked later.

At least that part cheered him up. Emma shook her head and grumbled , eyeing Lucas as if he too was guilty of misuse of one of her technological toys. Sally glanced sideways at her. “Relax, they improvised and came back alive, with the data we needed.” A small smile creeped across his face showing his annoyance was faked at best. “What was on the disc Sally?” Lucas asked Sally closed his eyes and thought on that. “We will cover that later” he said and gave Lucas a look that expected him to drop the conversation for now. He thought a moment about pushing it but after a time with Dyson he knew that Sally would probably just dig it , making it all that much harder to retrieve the information. So Lucas let it go. They waited for a few more moments and the doctor came in with Rolle trailing behind. Still a pronounced limp as he walked. The doc gave Lucas a slightly hostile looke “When we are done here, I expect you and glory boy to meet me in the med bay for a full checkup, he gave me the broad strokes of your misadventures, you two are damn lucky you weren’t killed” The doc chided.

Lucas smiled his best “what me worry” smile “Were fine doc” he said hoping to escape the tongue lashing that she had in store for them. The doc shook her head. “The medical bay, after the meeting, if I have to find you , you will not enjoy what I can cook up for fun” she finished and the smile on her face told Lucas he definitely would not enjoy it. So he just nodded and resigned himself to the doc’s ministrations after the meeting. Looking at Rolle he could see that he had already been the recipient of some of it, and he was not looking forward to a repeat performance.

Sally motioned everyone to come in so they could all hear. “Emma, do. You want to cover what we have learned today” he asked sounding more like a visiting professor calling on a TA to explain the assignment. Lucas smiled, Sally had a very maternal way of handling the group and it was something that he liked, not having had a mother for a long time he had not realized how much he missed that in his life.

It was something he would never say out loud and didn’t know if he could adequately express to him. He hoped one day he could, but that wouldn’t be today. He focused on Emma as the little woman gathered her thoughts. Victoria taking her hand for support and she looked at her lover and fiancé and flashed an appreciate smile squeezing her hand and letting her know how much she appreciated it.

“Okay, when I first found the machine, I thought it was something that I recognized, I explained a bit to Lucas so I will recap for the group. The system is a very early, probably an Alpha prototype build of the DSMS system or Detailed Sensor Memory Scanner that Department of Security use for there special forces troops. It allows the computer to record all of the brains sensory input and then records that information for later mining and reviewing by someone else. As I have said this is a very early system, I am not sure of the detail that it was able to record, I do know however that there are petabytes of recorded data from at least two test subjects. The first is a monkey that was used for early experimentation , it appears as If there were other subjects, but most of that data is corrupted” Emma looked around to see if everyone was keeping up, Rolle raised his hand and Emma motioned for him to speak.

“What do you mean sensory memory recording, is that like a video?” he asked confused at the term. Emma nodded expecting the question and explained.

“If you have never seen one or experienced one, then I could see the confusion. The brain experiences life, your environment, everything and records them as a series of electrical impulses that are sent to the brain and then translated by neural receptors. This includes, vision, hearing, feeling, smelling, thinking, every detail of your environment. This system records a live stream of those electrical impulses and records them within an optical drive.” She said and then looked at Rolle who was thoughtful for a moment, finally nodding he got at least the broad strokes of what Emma was saying but didn’t want to bog her down and slow her explanation by having her dumb it down even further. Lucas understood how he felt, even though he understood the theory, he had no idea how an electrical wire could record so much information and then translate it back so that the machine could process it, it sounded almost like magic to him.

Emma continued breaking Lucas out of his train of thought. So finally, the last full undamaged recording we have is of the last base commander.”

Emma said, and all eyes went to Lucas. “Joe Christian” she finished. Lucas felt a chill go up his spine, he had obviously never met the man, but here in this facility was an entire experience recorded by his blood, his experience and thoughts during a time before and probably near the end of the United States. What would that be like to see, to experience he wondered.

Lucas kept his thoughts to himself, looking back at the group who continued to look at him “Okay, why is everyone looking at me, we all knew he was the CO” he said. Sally nodded “Emma please continue” he said and everyone refocused there attention to the small woman and Lucas sighed with relief. “Okay, so we have all of the information , it looks like months and months of recordings from him. My guess he was fitted with a small sensor and aloud to just go about his job, while the system recorded.” She said and then stopped, she seemed to be expecting something and when it didn’t happen , she rolled her eyes. “Guys, all the access codes, passwords, orders, secret information , hell what happened at the end that caused this base to be hidden, its all there sitting on a drive. This is the rosetta stone of history , the manual for everythin we want to know about this base and were afraid to ask, this will give us full and unfettered access without having to go through and agonizingly break into every system and subsystem on this base” she continued. Still everyone was beginning to nod their heads, as if it was just now dawning on them. “This could also be an actual historically accurate history of what happened during the fall of the united states and the rise of new America, we would for the first time, know the truth” she said the excitement was evident and she shared a supportive looked with Victoria, it was obvious they had discussed this is great length for the past few hours while Rolle and Lucas were out.

Sally nudged her “How tell them the rest” and Emma winced, Lucas looked curiously at her, was there bad news he thought, was there a problem with the machine he wondered.

Emma sighed and continued “There is an issue, because this is a an early experiment, the data is all there, we have verified the sensory input system, but there is no mining system , no playback setup, so in otherwords there is no way to easily read the data.” Looking around Lucas could see the faces fall as she explained the issue, everyone understanding at least the general problem. It was a computer without a holoviewer, which made it pretty much useless, they couldn’t use the damn thing. He felt irritated and robbed somehow as if the information could have explained more about who he was and his history, things he didn’t know about his family and it was so close, yet.” he thought.

Emma looked around again and then continued, ensuring everyone was listening to the next part. “That doesn’t mean all is lost” faces came up and focused on her, suddenlty excited and hopeful again. “We can either spend a few months working on a viewing system, it won’t be perfect but it should allow us to at least go through parts of it and extract visual or audio data or maybe both” she paused, and looked at Sally who nodded to her “Or , we can ask for a volunteer, someone to plug directly into the machine and we reverse the sensors and send the stream of data back into their brain allowing there mind to translate and read the data” she said dropping the bomb. Without thinking Lucas stepped forward “Ill do it” he simply said, and everyone looked at him shocked. “It’s my Great Grandfather, this is an amazing chance to find out more about my family history as well as the history of our country” he said, then realized how lame his reason sounded. Blushing a bit, he stepped back, he was putting his own personal genealogical curiosity ahead of the mission, his reasons were very selfish, but he thought they were justified.

“Emma, do you want to continue” Sally said gently, looking at Lucas. Emma winced and glanced at Sally who nodded urging her to continue. “This is not without danger” she stared hesitating for a moment. “This might overload the persons mind causing a psychotic break, or it could confuse their sensory input, causing hallucinations or breaks with reality. Or worse yet, it could send them into a catatonic state” she finished looking at the floor.

No one spoke as they digested that information. Lucas struggled with this, part of him didn’t care the excitement of reliving a life of his direct blood line trumping the dangers, but another part weighed the possible outcomes and dangers and didn’t like the odds. “What kind of chance?” he finally asked, looking around the room. “are we talking likely or possibly?” he prodded, an edge of hope on the last word. Emma thought tryin to weigh in her mind and her experience the possibilities.

She sighed. “It has been tried, a direct tie in without a neural buffer or firewall to mitigate the sensor flow, the first few times it sent the test subjects into an insane rage as there mind tried to cope with decisions and information that they themselves wouldn’t have chosen. Let me give you an example.”

She looked at Lucas “Lets say we plug you into the replay of a mass murderer, and you experience him killing an entire family. Your mind would probably break as you watch yourself killing a family a decision you yourself couldn’t make, or perform but there it is , in your head as if you yourself did it. This would cause your phsycue to fracture as it tried to resolve your own ability to choose an action to that of one you couldn’t have chosen. It would split your conscious mind and would quite probably spawn a totally separate personality, one who could make that decision” She said.

Then made a calming motion with her hands. “We still do not fully understand what the human mind is capable of , or why it reacts certain ways to information or why some people did fine on the replay of sensory data and others went mad. “ She finished. Lucas could hear it in her words, she was resigning herself to giving up, to not allowing the data to be used. Lucas couldn’t have that, he had to know, he wanted to experience , he would take the chance and he thought quickly trying to grasp onto anything that could convince them of allowing him to try, but in all honesty , he didn’t care, he would do it out any more prodding, he had to do it, he didn’t know why he needed to, maybe it was some way to connect to his family, a family that was not present when he was growing up, or to keep memories of a person who once held his father on his lap and bounced the young child, telling him how proud he was of him. Lucas didn’t understand his own primal need; he just knew it existed.

“Emma, you said people went crazy because they couldn’t associate the decisions the person made with their own and that they couldn’t identify with the person they were experiencing correct” He asked, trying to keep the edge of desperation out of his voice. Emma looked thoughtful “Yes, at least that is the going theory, no one actually knows for sure” she said Lucas nodded, not caring at this point. “Well I have a connection, I have a personal connection, I honestly think that will help” he continued and looked around the room “Let me try, I will take full responsibility for the results, I understand the dangers, I don’t care I am willing to take the risk” he said, his eyes pleading as he looked between Emma and Sally.

Sally didn’t say anything for a long time, he looked at the floor, his eyes alight with thoughts and emotions and Lucas watched them carefully, he understood what Sally was doing, he was weighing the cost vs the reward, the loss of a good friend ot the information they would gain, he just stood there, silently. Lucas sighed “Sally, let me do it, its my decision, if something happens , it won’t be on you, besides if this works, we will have access to everything, plus who knows what else” Lucas said, trying his best to keep the pleading out of his voice. He didn’t want Sally or anyone else to know how desperate he was to try this.

Finally Sally looked up, his face was worried and Lucas could see the sadness in his eyes, he didn’t speak a word, but he nodded and Lucas almost cheered with excitement, but he put on a neutral face and then hugged the big man “Thank you Sally, this means everything to me” he said his voice husky with emotion and his eye welling up with tears.

He turned to Emma “What now?” he asked shrugging. Emma smiled, but it was a wan smile, one of worry but also excitement as her mind was alight recognizing problems and then solving them. “Well this is going to take a bit, I need to pick up some things, we need to move a medical bed in so the doc can monitor you while you are under and I need some lead sensors and some other electronics to ensure that I can replace some of the old equipment with a better receptor system” she said. “In a week we can start” She finished, looking at Victoria to ensure he hadn’t missed anything, but her fiancé nodded. “About a week” she confirmed. Lucas almost groaned with impatience, but he held back, he didn’t need to act like a petulant child now.
